description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nishsamkamallpura, Thamankaduwa  D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No.120285 (23/0907)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details of land parcel numbers, extents, ownership information, and legal status. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, specifically title settlement and registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
